verdict.rationale: Sentry documents a first-party Server-Side Data Scrubbing feature, so the server-side half of the story exists. The evidence is only a page title with no detail on rule types, PII patterns, or whether scrubbing happens before persistence, and nothing covers SDK-level filtering. missing for 10: SDK-level filtering evidence (client-side hooks or options), detail on server-side scrubbing rules, confirmation that scrubbing happens before data persists, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can scrub PII from error events — server-side scrubbing rules plus SDK-level filtering — before sensitive payloads ever persist
